title: Joplin integration
summary: NewsBlur already supports sharing a story to Evernote. Would be nice to have an integration to send the note to Joplin, which is a FOSS alternative to Evernote. I don’t use Obsidian, but I imagine as it is similar to Joplin (being a free alternative to Evernote, with an even larger userbase) could also be interesting. I don’t know about Obsidian, but Joplin supports WebClipper which might help.
body_markdown:
[SteveBuscemiDress](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/SteveBuscemiDress)


September 25, 2026, 6:50am 1


NewsBlur already supports sharing a story to Evernote.


Would be nice to have an integration to send the note to Joplin, which is a FOSS alternative to Evernote.


I don’t use Obsidian, but I imagine as it is similar to Joplin (being a free alternative to Evernote, with an even larger userbase) could also be interesting.


I don’t know about Obsidian, but Joplin supports WebClipper which might help.


1 Like


[Sternenstaub](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/Sternenstaub)


September 25, 2026, 7:16am 2


I switched from Evernote to Joplin when Evernote finally shut down the legacy version. I’ve never regretted the move—Joplin is what Evernote used to be and should have remained. Yes, integration with Newsblur would be great!
